d: After spending a carefree summer in New York with Noel, Felicity embarks on her senior year feeling lost and uncertain  Ben returns wanting to become a doctor.
When Felicity is asked to perform a nuptial ceremony for two close friends, she balks because of her confused feelings about love.
Collegiate financial woes overshadow Felicity's romantic worries  Sean frets he'll be embarrassed when his folks meet Meghan's sophisticated parents.
Javier coaches Felicity on costumes, hairdos and dance numbers, as she prepares to compete in a beauty pageant for the much-needed prize money.
Javier drags Noel to Atlantic City to see Lionel Richie in concert  Ben and his lab partner go on a drinking binge after getting kicked out of chemistry class.
On Felicity's 21st birthday, Ben deals with his father's (John Ritter) failing health  Noel reveals information that leads to an ugly fight with Ben.
Felicity is pained by Ben's chilly silence after Noel revealed that he and Felicity slept together  Noel wallows in self-destructive behavior.
Everyone is stunned when Ben shows up at Felicity's Thanksgiving dinner with a date  Noel's behavior spirals out of control, and he winds up in handcuffs.
